entries.en: Can I see what you have?
Lot of Tyger Claws around here.
Please! I'm sure you will find something you like.
entries.ro: Te rog! Sunt sigur că găsești ceva ce-ți place.

entries.en: Real hoppin' place. Lots of Tygers roaming especially.
entries.en_m: Real hoppin' place. Lot of Tygers roaming especially.
entries.ro: Loc tare animat. Tot felul de Tygers pe aici, mai ales.

entries.en: From different walks of life, many of them.
entries.ro: Din medii diferite, mulți dintre ei.
Doar că nu le plac întrebările.
